item.title: Build 718
item.description:
• Schedule. A new Schedule row in the sidebar shows every todo with a due date on a month, with previous, next and Today controls and a project filter. Opening it from a project starts on that project. Click an item to see its note's "Before posting" list, copy the post, tick it, open the note or move its date, without leaving the month. Done items stay on their day. On the iPhone, the Todos tab has a List and Schedule switch with a compact month and the day's items below it.
  • Platform, images and your calendar in Schedule. A post shows where it goes (the Platform and Account lines in its note) and its images, which can be copied, opened full size, or added by dropping a file on the post. Events from the calendars Mayfly already reads appear on the month in quieter text, after your own items, and are left out when they repeat a post's title. A Calendar checkbox on the Mac, and a menu item on the iPhone, switches them off.
  • Posts due today. A post that is due today, or was due and is not ticked, shows as a plain line at the top of the notes list on the Mac and in a Posts due section on the iPhone's Today screen, with the number due on the Schedule row. Clicking it opens the post. One notification is sent on the day, at 9:00 am unless you change it in Settings, and none for a post you have ticked.
  • Save a post's images. The Mac saves an image as the file it holds, from the image strip, the full-size viewer and Media, and an image can be dragged out to Finder or a browser. The iPhone has a share button on each image, which includes Save to Photos and AirDrop.
  • Due dates on import. A Markdown file with a due: date in its frontmatter now arrives with a todo for that day, linked to its note. Importing the same folder again does not duplicate it.
